description: I/O contract of the WP3 Core ML models (mil/build.py) for the Swift harness. Encoder, Decoder and JointDecision follow C0's contract (c0.json) so they load like C0; JointLogits and DecoderJoint are new.

layout.encoder: <root>/<model>/<arm>/<variant>.mlmodelc with <variant> in fixed, multi, enum; <model> in mp2, seed0 (G0: <root>/c0/G0/fixed.mlmodelc)

mel.note: log-mel, NeMo feature contract; frames >= mel_length must be 0

mel_length.note: valid mel frames M = N // 160 (NeMo). C0's preprocessor reports N // 160 + 1.

encoder.bucket_rule: an utterance of N samples uses the smallest bucket b with N <= 16000 b (clips.py bucket_of)

multi.note: load with MLModelConfiguration.functionName; weights shared between functions in weight.bin

encoder.compute_precision: FP16 (C5: int8 activations at the ternary matmul inputs, exploratory)

Decoder.start: zero h/c and targets = 1024 (blank/SOS; its embedding row is zero), reset per utterance

token_prob: softmax over the same 1,025, at token_id
duration: argmax bin of the 5 duration logits; frames = durations[bin], durations = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]

JointLogits.use: diagnostics and gate 4 (replay); not for timing

DecoderJoint.semantics: runs the prediction network on targets from (h_in, c_in), then the joint on (encoder_step, its output). Keep (targets, h_in, c_in) = (last emitted token or 1024 at start, the state before that token was consumed). After a blank: same (targets, h_in, c_in), next encoder_step. After emitting token k: targets = k, (h_in, c_in) = the h_out/c_out of this call. One call per joint step; the prediction network is recomputed on blank steps (its cost is part of the fused arm).

decoding.strategy: NeMo greedy_batch label looping (reference.run_steps): blank with duration 0 advances 1 frame; max_symbols 10 per frame
